nodes.description: Constant maximum number of mintable VosNFT tokens (9999).
Private linear price in wei for one token, set through setTokenPrice.
Maximum number of tokens that can be minted in a single public transaction.
Flag enabling/disabling the public sale phase.
Flag enabling/disabling the team sale phase.
Mutable nonce/seed used in the pseudo-random index generation.
Swap-and-pop index array used to map pseudo-random slots to token ids.
Mapping of addresses authorised to mint during the team sale.
PaymentSplitter total shares used to compute pending payments.
PaymentSplitter mapping of already released Ether per account.
ReentrancyGuard status used to compute paused()/nonReentrant behaviour.
Base URI prefix used to build token metadata URIs.
Internal function generating a pseudo-random token index from nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
Private function that mints a token with a pseudo-random id via _safeMint.
Payable, nonReentrant, whenNotPaused public mint entry point validating supply, sale flag, max-per-tx and exact payment.
Payable, nonReentrant team mint entry point gated by teamSale flag and team address whitelist.
onlyOwner setter for the token price.
onlyOwner setter for the per-transaction mint cap.
onlyOwner function enabling public sale and resetting the per-tx cap to 20.
onlyOwner function disabling public sale and resetting the per-tx cap to 1.
onlyOwner function toggling the team sale flag.
onlyOwner function updating the metadata base URI.
onlyOwner function pausing or unpausing the contract.
PaymentSplitter function computing and sending the pending Ether share to an account via Address.sendValue.
Private view computing the pending payment from total received, shares and already released amounts.
Private function registering a payee and accumulating total shares.
Constructor initialising PaymentSplitter/ERC721, setting the token price and team whitelist flag.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used as randomness seed, mint recipient and team membership key.
Miner-influenceable block.timestamp used as a pseudo-randomness input.
Weak/predictable randomness derived from keccak256(nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty, block.timestamp).
Low-level external ETH transfer (Address.sendValue / recipient.call{value:}) allowing reentry.
External callback to recipient contract through _safeMint -> onERC721Received during minting.
Arithmetic multiplication of token price by the requested amount used for payment validation.
Parameter _amount of mintPublicMultipleTokens.
Parameter _amount of mintTeamMultipleTokens.
Parameter _price of setTokenPrice.
Parameter _count of setMaxTokensAtOnce.
Parameter _uri of setBaseUri.
Parameter account of release, the payee receiving Ether.
Local variable index holding the computed pseudo-random slot.
Local variable value holding the selected token id before the +1 offset.
Local variable _tokenID in _mintWithRandomTokenId.
Loop counter i in mintPublicMultipleTokens.
Local variable payment in release holding the amount to transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as part of the randomness seed in randomIndex.
msg.sender is forwarded as the mint recipient in mintPublicMultipleTokens.
msg.sender is used as the whitelist key _teamSaleAddresses[msg.sender] gating mintTeamMultipleTokens.
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random index computed in randomIndex (timestamp dependency).
randomIndex performs the weak randomness operation.
index array indices is read and written while selecting the token id.
nonce is read as part of the randomness seed.
nonce is incremented after each random index generation.
_mintWithRandomTokenId calls randomIndex to obtain the token id.
_safeMint triggers the onERC721Received callback on the recipient contract.
mintPublicMultipleTokens loops calling _mintWithRandomTokenId for each requested token.
mintTeamMultipleTokens loops calling _mintWithRandomTokenId for each requested token.
mintPublicMultipleTokens multiplies token price by amount to validate msg.value.
_tokenPrice is read via getTokenPrice for the payment multiplication.
publicSale flag gates execution of mintPublicMultipleTokens.
_maxTokensAtOnce caps the mint amount in mintPublicMultipleTokens.
TOKEN_LIMIT bounds total supply in mintPublicMultipleTokens.
teamSale flag gates execution of mintTeamMultipleTokens.
_teamSaleAddresses whitelist authorises the caller of mintTeamMultipleTokens.
TOKEN_LIMIT bounds total supply in mintTeamMultipleTokens.
setTokenPrice writes _tokenPrice.
Parameter _price is assigned to _tokenPrice.
setMaxTokensAtOnce writes _maxTokensAtOnce.
Parameter _count is assigned to _maxTokensAtOnce.
enablePublicSale sets publicSale to true.
enablePublicSale calls setMaxTokensAtOnce(20).
disablePublicSale sets publicSale to false.
disablePublicSale calls setMaxTokensAtOnce(1).
toggleTeamSale flips the teamSale flag.
setBaseUri writes baseURI.
Parameter _uri is assigned to baseURI.
togglePaused reads/writes the ReentrancyGuard/Pausable status through pause state toggles.
release calls _pendingPayment to compute the amount owed.
release reads and updates the _released mapping of the caller.
release forwards the computed payment to the external ETH transfer operation.
The low-level ETH call can re-enter release before state effects finalise.
Parameter account selects the payee and transfer target in release.
Local payment holds the computed amount added to _released and transferred.
_totalShares is the divisor in the pending payment computation.
alreadyReleased is subtracted in the pending payment computation.
The constructor invokes _addPayee for each configured team payee.
_addPayee accumulates shares into _totalShares.
The constructor calls setTokenPrice with the initial price.
The constructor flags the team address in _teamSaleAddresses.
Parameter _amount drives the supply, cap and payment checks in mintPublicMultipleTokens.
Parameter _amount drives the supply check and mint loop in mintTeamMultipleTokens.
Local index stores the computed modulo slot in randomIndex.
Local value stores the selected token id in randomIndex.
Local _tokenID holds the id returned by randomIndex before _safeMint.
Loop counter i controls the mint iteration count in mintPublicMultipleTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter only exists to drive the mint loop and validation inside mintPublicMultipleTokens.
The _amount parameter only exists to drive the mint loop and supply check inside mintTeamMultipleTokens.
The _price parameter is only used to assign the _tokenPrice state variable in setTokenPrice.
The _count parameter is only used to assign _maxTokensAtOnce in setMaxTokensAtOnce.
The _uri parameter is only used to assign baseURI in setBaseUri.
The account parameter is only used inside release to look up shares and transfer Ether.
Local index exists only for the index computation inside randomIndex.
Local value exists only for the token id selection inside randomIndex.
Local _tokenID exists only to pass the random index into _safeMint.
Loop counter i exists only to repeat the mint call inside mintPublicMultipleTokens.
Local payment exists only to hold the amount released in the release function.
